definitions.explanation: A numerical index that combines temperature and humidity to express how uncomfortable the weather feels. Commonly referenced in Japanese weather forecasts during summer months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不快指数|ふかいしすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧80⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えている→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
{不快指数|ふかいしすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: When the discomfort index is high, the risk of heatstroke also increases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧{不快指数|ふかいしすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: During the rainy season, humidity is high and the discomfort index tends to rise, so many people use air conditioning.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently used in weather forecasts and news reports during Japan's hot and humid summer months. A discomfort index above 75 is considered uncomfortable, and above 80 is very uncomfortable. The index is calculated from temperature and relative humidity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不快指数|ふかいしすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (the discomfort index is high)
- {不快指数|ふかいしすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (the discomfort index rises)
- {不快指数|ふかいしすう}80⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧ (discomfort index of 80 or above)
